2. Add Country Page: Layout & Page Actions Matrix (Req 2 & 4)

Verified Features: Desktop 3-column / 4-column balanced grid layout, Country Name field equipped with World Lookup Table icon (🔍), Status radio switches (Active / Draft), Default switch card with live badge Preview: Default = False, empty flag upload dropzone by default, and right-side Page Actions matrix displaying Add Active with instant navigation buttons to Edit Country and View Country.

Figure 1: Add Country Initial Page Layout with Open Right Action Panel showing Add Active Matrix

3. World Country Lookup Table Modal (Req 1.A & 7)

Verified Features: Clicking the 🔍 button opens the World Country Lookup Table modal containing 60+ standard records. Real-time search for "United Arab" filters matching entries instantly. Includes continent pills (All, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Africa, Oceania) and full keyboard navigation (Arrow Up/Down, Enter to select, Esc to close).

Figure 2: World Country Lookup Table Modal with search for "United Arab" and Continent Filters

Verified Features: Clicking "Select" loads the official record into Country Name ("United Arab Emirates"), ISO Code 2 ("AE"), ISO Code 3 ("ARE"), Numeric ("784"), Phone Dial Code ("+971"), Currency ("AED — UAE Dirham"), and Nationality ("Emirati"). Toast notification confirms data is loaded for review without saving immediately.

Figure 3: Form Fields populated from Lookup Table with Green Checkmarks and Review Toast

4. Manual Entry with Country Master Autocomplete (Req 1.B)

Verified Features: Typing manually into the Country Name field triggers a debounced search against existing Country Master records. Dropdown displays matching permanent entries (United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates) with official flag icons and dial codes. Selecting a suggestion fills the field without silently overwriting the master record.

Figure 4: Debounced Country Master Autocomplete Suggestions Dropdown

5. Difference Warning Notice (Req 1.C)

Verified Features: When the user modifies text after selecting a master or lookup record, an amber difference banner immediately appears: "Notice: Modified name differs from selected record: United States. The record will not silently overwrite the original master record." The modified name is preserved for new saving.

Figure 5: Live Amber Difference Warning Notice Banner

6. Default Country Switch & Live Preview (Req 3)

Verified Features: Toggling the Default switch ON updates the preview badge to Preview: Default = True in bright sky blue. Under the single default country rule, setting a new default country automatically unsets any prior default upon saving.

Figure 6: Default Country Switch toggled ON with Live Preview: Default = True

7. View Country Mode: Editable Name & Actions (Req 5)

Verified Features: In View Country mode, the Country Name card displays an "Editable in View" badge with edit pen icon. The right panel displays the "View Active" matrix with quick Add and Edit actions. The bottom footer features the AI Assistance button.

Figure 7: View Country Details Page with Editable in View Badge and View Active Matrix

Verified Features: Editing the Country Name directly in View mode triggers the floating inline action bar with "Cancel" and "Save Changes" buttons, allowing quick inline modifications without switching to full edit mode.

8. Edit Country Mode & Reset Button (Req 6)
